title: Mute users on Hacker News
question: Can I block or mute a user on Hacker News?
answer: Hacker News has no block, mute or ignore feature, logged in or not. The usermods script on this page adds a mute link to the header of every comment. Click it and that person's comments fold down to a single greyed header line across every thread, with an unmute link to bring them back. The list is kept in your browser and works without an account. Without a script, the only option is collapsing their comments one at a time with [–].
prompt: Add a mute button to Hacker News comments that hides everything a user writes.
details:
The muted names are stored in `localStorage` for news.ycombinator.com, so they stay in the browser where you clicked and are not sent anywhere. You can also put names in the `MUTED` list at the top of the script to mute them in every browser you install it on.

A muted comment keeps its header line, so the thread structure stays readable and replies to it are still shown. Stories submitted by muted users are left alone.

The check opens a comment thread, clicks mute on one user and confirms both of their comments fold while the other comments stay visible.

alternatives.title: Collapse a thread
alternatives.body: Click **[–]** next to a comment to fold it and its replies. It applies to that one comment and its replies, not to the person who wrote it.
